about: Every outside source this workspace may draw on. Anything not listed here is off limits to the agent. Git projects are fetched read-only into .sources/ by `npm run sources -- sync`. See .kiro/steering/sources.md.

projects.name: NICE Design System
projects.about: The design system's own repository. Used only for the 'when to use' guidance in its docs, which is added to the catalogue. Components themselves come from the published packages.

projects.name: NICE website (next-web)
projects.about: The main NICE website. Scanned for components that could be retrofitted into the design system. Also the reference for how production code is written, since designs are ported to it.

projects.name: Global nav
projects.about: The NICE header and footer used on every site. Designs never rebuild the header or footer: they are out of scope. Scanned so the agent knows what the site chrome provides and for pieces that might belong in the design system.
